# Go Vocal design system

> Go Vocal's admin components: React Aria Components 1.22 painted only with `--gv-*` design tokens (from Figma),
> shown in Storybook, with a demo back office built from them alone. Import from three entry points; reach for a
> Component first; paint only with the tokens.

Generated by `npm run components:index` from the stories, beside docs/COMPONENTS.md; never edit by hand.

- Entry points: `govocal-ds` (Components, Patterns, `AppProvider`, React Aria's value types),
  `govocal-ds/base` (Base parts), `govocal-ds/tokens.css` (the tokens, imported once at the app's root). Never
  import a file path.
- Wrap the app once in `AppProvider` (locale, router, the toast region). Words a part says come in as props.
- Paint only with `var(--gv-*)`, semantic tokens first, from tokens.json (below); never guess a token name.
- Three tiers, in the order to reach for them: Components, Patterns, Base (one section each, below).

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andratwiro/govocal-ds/main/AGENTS.md): the agent's map: tiers, entry points, finding a part, tokens, commands, MCP servers, hard rules
- [API.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andratwiro/govocal-ds/main/docs/API.md): imports, props, `className` and `style`, the naming convention
- [COMPONENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andratwiro/govocal-ds/main/docs/COMPONENTS.md): one line per Storybook entry: its export, what it is for, its stories
- [CONSUMING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andratwiro/govocal-ds/main/docs/CONSUMING.md): using it from another app: the build, CSS scoping, providers, forms
- [tokens.json](https://andratwiro.github.io/govocal-ds/tokens.json): every `--gv-*` token as DTCG JSON, with its purpose
- [Components manifest](https://andratwiro.github.io/govocal-ds/storybook/manifests/components.json): every entry's props and its stories' code

## Components

Generic parts any admin could ship, from `govocal-ds`. Reach for one first.

- Data display: `ActivityFeed`, `Avatar`, `FileList`, `Illustration`, `ListHeader`, `ListHeaderCell`, `ListRow`, `MapView`, `PropertyList`, `ReactionCounts`, `StatRow`, `StatTile`
- Overlays: `AlertDialog`, `Coachmark`, `HelpPopover`, `Modal`, `SidePanel`, `Tooltip`
- Layout & containers: `AppProvider`, `Card`, `Divider`, `Grid`, `Inline`, `PageHeader`, `PageStage`, `Panel`, `Stack`, `TileGrid`, `ZoomBar`
- Status & feedback: `Badge`, `Banner`, `EmptyState`, `MissingPart`, `NewDot`, `ReviewStatus`, `Skeleton`, `StatusBadge`, `Toast`
- Charts: `BarRow`, Chart (`LineChart`), `DashboardCard`, `LegendRow`, `StatementRow`
- Navigation: `Breadcrumbs`, `Link`, `Pagination`, `Tabs`
- Actions: `Button`, `CompactButton`, `IconButton`, `Menu`, `SegmentedControl`
- AI: `ChatMessage`, `ChatProgress`, `ChatThread`, `ItemChip`, `PromptComposer`, `PromptSuggestions`
- Forms: `Checkbox`, `CheckboxGroup`, `ChoiceCard`, `DateRangeField`, `DropZone`, `LocaleSwitcher`, `MultilingualRichTextEditor`, `MultilingualTextField`, `NumberField`, `OptionList`, `RadioGroup`, `RequiredMarker`, `RichTextEditor`, `RichTextToolbar`, `RichTextToolbarButton`, `SearchField`, `Select`, `Switch`, `TagPicker`, `TextField`, `TitleField`
- Tables & lists: `DataTable`, `TableToolbar`, `FilterChips`, `FilterMenu`, `SelectionBar`
- Text: `SectionLabel`, `Text`, `VisuallyHidden`

## Patterns

Go Vocal assemblies from `govocal-ds`, grouped by the screen they belong to; their props speak phases, methods, projects. Use one when your screen is that place.

- Build tab: `AccessRights`, Form field summary, `NotificationRow`, `ParticipantActionRow`, `ViewOptionRow`
- Project page: `ActionRow`, `PanelSection`, `PhonePreview`, `ProjectHeader`, `SetupStep`, `StatCard`
- App shell: `AppFrame`, `NotificationList`, `SideNav`
- Report builder: `AssistantPanel`
- Manage tab: `CommentThread`, `OfficialUpdate`
- Participation methods: `CommonGroundRow`, `ProposalsRow`, `VolunteeringRow`, `VoteProgress`, `VotingRow`
- Project rail: `PhaseTimeline`, `RailHeader`, `RailPhase`
- Pages & menu: `SectionToggle`
- Recipes: Form validation, Integration seams

## Base

React Aria's starter parts painted with the tokens, from `govocal-ds/base`. Only when no Component does the job, never in place of one.

- `Calendar`, `Checkbox`, `ColorField`, `ColorSwatch`, `DateField`, `DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`, `Dialog`, `Disclosure`, `DisclosureGroup`, `Form`, `GridList`, `ListBox`, `Meter`, `Modal`, `Popover`, `RangeCalendar`, `Table`, `TagGroup`, `TimeField`, `ToggleButton`, `Toolbar`, `Tree`

## Optional

- [Storybook](https://andratwiro.github.io/govocal-ds/storybook/): every part, every state, left to right and right to left
- [The back office](https://andratwiro.github.io/govocal-ds/backoffice/): a demo admin built only from the entry points
- [HOW-TO.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andratwiro/govocal-ds/main/docs/HOW-TO.md): the designer's recipes: change a token, a look, add a story
- [NAMING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andratwiro/govocal-ds/main/docs/NAMING.md): names, the Storybook tree, tags, what becomes a component
- [DESIGN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andratwiro/govocal-ds/main/docs/DESIGN.md): why it is built this way
